name: Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd.
summary: Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufactures and sale of automotive parts, industrial materials and high-performance elastomer products in Japan, China, Asia, Europe, America, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Auto Parts Business, Industrial Materials Business, and High-Performance Elastomer Products business.
